event: Dayo finds the last two crawlers isolated in a root alcove at a side corridor's end.
Dayo Shield Rushes the first crawler into the fungal wall.
Dayo catches the flanking second on her buckler and punches through its carapace.
Nadia calls it the most anticlimactic victory of their careers.
The System shows Floor 7 full clear, 96/96, bonus All Secrets Found complete.
Solenne says the bonus room trigger should be a structural change in the corridor.
Nadia translates: the wall does something weird; Solenne agrees.
Tomás waits forty meters down the corridor, head angled at the south wall.
The south wall silently folds open on a hidden room.
The party enters a small crystal-lit room with three cache alcoves and one more.
Vesper goes in first and starts inventorying aloud.
First alcove: tower-crystal fragments, binding compound, an unknown dark fiber.
Second alcove: a large pre-graded Tier II reward Core.
Third alcove: two healing potions, a Mana Vial and a Skill Book.
Vesper lifts out the Skill Book: Combat Perception, Tier I passive.
Vesper says she doesn't need it and gives it to Dayo.
Dayo takes the Skill Book; it dissolves into her forearm.
Dayo says 'Huh': she can feel where everyone is; Nadia asks good or bad; 'Good huh'.
Solenne records the inventory in her notebook.
Solenne notices Tomás crouched at the fourth, empty alcove.
Tomás says there was a trap here.
Tomás says the pressure-plate trap was sprung and reset.
Vesper notes the System resets traps on floor resets, and stops inventorying.
Tomás says it was manually reset to look unsprung, from memory.
Solenne says someone was here.
Tomás estimates a stealthy solo or pair, 36 to 48 hours ahead of them.
Tomás keeps his further opinions to himself.
Solenne tries to connect the Quest, the doors and the climber; the threads won't converge.
Solenne freezes, pen stopped mid-sentence, with no next step.
Miriam senses the shift and chooses to wait, since someone else is moving.
Dayo crosses the room and stands close beside Solenne without words or touch.
Nadia reads the room and turns to the crystal alcoves.
Nadia names the first alcove Gary.
Nadia names the second Gary's Ambitious Cousin who got into cryptocurrency.
Nadia stalls on the third: it might not be Gary's fault.
Vesper asks why his name is Gary; Nadia says all alcoves are Gary.
Dayo laughs, cracking the stillness.
Solenne's pen moves again; she is back.
Solenne notes the unknown climber, underlining 'question for later' twice.
Miriam catalogs the remaining cache materials.
Solenne says they should move; the exit gate should be active.
The party enters the amber, black-stone Transition Hall.
A System terminal floats on the hall's left wall.
The Floor 7 clear notification arrives: 96/96, no deaths, 10,728 XP.
XP settles into all six Status Windows.
Miriam levels up from Warden 8 to 9; Mending Touch rises to level 9.
A green glow settles into Miriam's hands; she flexes them.
Solenne announces Miriam's nine and the stat gains.
Dayo jokes Miriam can now heal her harder; Miriam says she heals adequately.
Dayo says with more enthusiasm; Miriam's mouth twitches and she closes her window.
Nadia checks her XP bar, still not nine; Solenne says she's closer.
Tomás says Dayo is closest to twelve; 'I pay attention.'
The party settles into their usual places in the Hall.
Solenne stands at the center and decides not to hold the Quest alone.
Solenne says she needs to tell them something; the Hall goes quiet.
Solenne tells them of the gold-bordered personal Quest from the rest node.
Solenne reads the Quest text aloud.
Solenne admits she has no plan for the doors, the Quest or the climber.
Dayo says 'Okay'; Solenne says 'Okay' back.
Solenne thinks of the Compact's Floor 8 scout report: flooded, aquatic.
Solenne puts the notebook away and says 'Whenever you're ready.'
